parameters.name: Maxage
parameters.description: The effective period of the block, in seconds. Specify this parameter when the type is block.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type. Valid values:

- **block**: Block.
- **unblock**: Unblock.
